result:
The success notification for team creation now lives in the mutation hook, not the component. I did not run tests, lint, or the app, as you asked.

- **`apps/react-vite/src/features/teams/api/create-team.ts`**: `useCreateTeam` calls `useNotifications` and fires `addNotification({ type: 'success', title: 'Team Created' })` in `onSuccess`, after the query invalidation and before the caller's `onSuccess`.
- **`apps/react-vite/src/features/teams/components/create-team.tsx`**: removed the `useNotifications` import and the notification call. The component now calls `useCreateTeam()` with no `mutationConfig`.

The `teams.tsx` route did not call `useNotifications`, so it needed no change.

Other feature components in the repo (discussions, comments, users) still call `useNotifications` directly. I left them alone because you scoped the fix to the new code. They break the same rule, so they may be worth a follow-up.
